messages:
rachael: quick check — I hit a 404 in the onboarding KB (runtime/getting-started). image link is to the old CDN. anyone from docs own onboarding assets?

matt: pinging @alex — you around to take ownership? can be a tiny rehost if needed.

alex: I can pick this up. which file + line?

rachael: runtime/getting-started.md around the screenshot block. exact URL: https://old-cdn.redwood-assets/example-screenshot.png -> 403.

docs-bot: automated scan flagged asset-rot for runtime/getting-started.md (scan id 1723999000). created ticket DOCS-342 in docs backlog.

alex: OK grabbing. plan: download screenshot, upload to internal S3, update path + alt text, and open PR.

sam: quick Q — do we need a security review for rehosting third-party image?

alex: it's just a product screenshot (no PII). I'll include source attribution + original URL in PR description. if sec wants to jump in they can.

maria: I can review once CI is green. please add a short changelog line so ops can verify the rehost automation.

rachael: can you add one more thing: in the PR description include the scan ticket ID (DOCS-342) so the scan can auto-close. :thumbsup:

alex: got it — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1892. description includes provenance, s3 path, and DOCS-342. ETA: today EOD.

matt: nice, thanks alex. once merged can someone kick a quick smoke to confirm onboarding preview works?

maria: I'll do that.

rachael: awesome. marking this claimed. thanks all.
